scope: Exploration trajectories only; no full ground truth. Reference images are single views; hidden geometry and absolute scale are unknown.

S01-E4-R1.guidance: actual_guidance.txt proposes whole assembly versus caster revision and checking every wheel
S01-E4-R1.observations: Candidate implementations were executed, images and side views read, and final caster revision selected. Both initial checks recorded -0.001 sampled gap; final rounded gaps were approximately zero. These are sampled vertical measurements, not proof of contact or connection. Camera was subsequently revised.

S01-E4-R2.observations: Both candidates were rendered and sampled checks rounded near zero; caster alternative retained seat height and was selected. Later changes included framing and material edits; no final repeat of the check appears in the events.

S02-E4-R1.guidance: actual_guidance.txt requests visibility diagnosis and fixed-camera swing versus hinge placement comparison
S02-E4-R1.observations: Multiple swing and relocated hinge candidates and diagnostic renders executed; selected right-wall door and opening differ from reference. Student explicitly reports side view obstructed, leaving intersections and hinge alignment unverified. A later candidate G was rendered and viewed but no later retention is established; final build remains the preceding selection. Reject as transferable structural repair.

S02-E4-R2.guidance: same visibility and hinge comparison proposal
S02-E4-R2.observations: Wall hiding diagnosis was rendered, a real opening constructed, swings and widths compared, top and side views inspected for an intermediate candidate, then that swing retained. Student reports leaf still too narrow. These views alone do not establish collision-free motion.

S03-E4-R1.guidance: actual_guidance.txt requests mapped procedural, image, and roughness candidates with alternate lighting
S03-E4-R1.observations: Three candidates were rendered under original and alternate light, six images read, and image candidate selected. Generated coordinates were used despite a source comment calling them world-space; do not infer world-space mapping from the comment.

S03-E4-R2.observations: Three candidates and alternate lights rendered and read; image texture generated in source and packed was retained. Contact sheet attempt failed due to missing Pillow; do not claim a crop-sheet comparison occurred.

claimed_unit_origins.spatial: Door visibility comparisons plus general projective and hinge geometry; no historical selected door is endorsed as a structural repair.
claimed_unit_origins.appearance: Material candidate comparisons plus independently written procedural node hypothesis; no historical texture copied.
claimed_unit_origins.support: Chair candidate sampling and side-view workflow plus conservative interpretation from geometry prior.

rejected_candidates: Whole-chair lowering was not selected in chair runs, although sampled near-floor results do not prove it invalid generally.
The S02 R1 selected door placement is not a general repair because the final hinge and opening coherence is not verified.
Unselected roughness and procedural countertop candidates are not globally disproved.
verification: Historical student checks are separate from any new synthetic tests. See /app/check_library.py and its execution output for current implementation checks.
unknowns: No GT inspection or original generation trajectory was available.
No independent selection reference or unseen-scene evaluation has been performed.
Historical side-view and sampled contact checks cannot prove continuous collision-free articulation or physical support.
